Schema per https://developer.amazon.com/docs/alexaplus/add-ons/category-sdk-create-mcp-addon.html. Remove this _comment key before using — addon.json itself does not allow unknown keys.

en-US.shortDescription: A pantry and cooking companion that never guesses — plans your week, walks a recipe, and says when it doesn't know.
en-US.fullDescription: Mise tracks what's at home, plans meals around what's already on hand and what's about to turn, and walks a recipe step by step with a session that remembers where you left off. Every answer keeps what you reported, what a device sensed, and what was only worked out, visibly distinct — an estimate is never presented as a fact, and a gap in the data is answered honestly instead of filled in. When something is out, Mise substitutes from a chef-curated table or says plainly that it has nothing curated for that. When something is about to turn, Zero Waste pairs a recipe already in your kitchen with a short technique lesson, without claiming a measured amount of money or waste saved. The weekly plan carries its own hash, so the same pantry and the same week produce the same plan every time — ask it to explain a change and it tells you exactly what moved and why.
examplePhrases: Plan my dinners for the week
Let's make the lentil stew, for four
The tofu expires tomorrow, what can I do with it?
